Extracts full Open Graph metadata from a page

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.metadata.og_title.inspect
puts result.metadata.og_type.inspect
puts result.metadata.og_image.inspect
puts result.metadata.og_description.inspect
puts result.metadata.title.inspect
```
